_about.purpose: Pilot for the 'Paid out & sales enabled' measure: test formula A (cash: revenue − operating cash flow + capex) against B (accrual: costs − D&A − SBC + interest paid + taxes paid + capex).
_about.unit: billions of the reporting currency; 'stated' is the figure as printed (millions; Reliance ₹ crore = 0.01 billion)

formulas.A: Revenue − Operating cash flow + Capex (+ interest paid and/or taxes paid only where classified outside operating cash flow)
formulas.B: Total costs and expenses − D&A − share-based comp + interest paid + taxes paid + Capex (as specified)
formulas.B_prime: B with interest expense already inside total costs removed before adding cash interest paid (avoids double count)
